description: This file defines a web API endpoint for user authentication within the eShopOnWeb project. It handles login requests, verifies credentials via SignInManager, and generates tokens upon successful authentication.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling user authentication requests. Uses SignInManager for credential validation and ITokenClaimsService for token generation.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the authentication request, attempts login, and returns an authentication response with user token if successful.
